1) Full pentest report sharing: We can provide the full pen-test report under an NDA. I can route the report via a secure signed link (we use DocuSign + secure S3 link)  sending link once NDA is complete.

2) SLAs for Dedicated: Our standard vulnerability SLA (applies to Dedicated customers with a signed contract) is: Critical: 14 days to mitigation or published remediation plan; High: 30 days; Medium: 90 days; Low: 180 days. We are open to contracting a 14-day Critical SLA for Acme as part of the Dedicated SOW.

We have a documented data retention and deletion policy  attaching a short export (Vuln-Management-SLA-Table.csv) and linking our policy. - Continuous host monitoring + daily alerting for infra anomalies.
- Weekly internal CVE scanning + prioritized triage workflow in Jira.
- Monthly authenticated app scans (DAST) with results pushed to our vulnerability tracker.
- Quarterly external penetration tests for internet-exposed systems; annual full-application pentest.
- Responsible disclosure: we publish a security contact and handle third-party reports; coordinated disclosure timeframe is 90 days depending on severity and exploitability.
